title: 第3205章 他真的没有掌控这件神级宝物啊好气啊有点虚第3204章 那样我会很失望的哟前辈看起来精神不错嘛太粗糙了
content_zh:
轰隆隆！
整座小世界的力量都汇聚而来，融入那深蓝色漩涡之中。
漩涡在扩大，不断从王腾头顶朝着阴雷尊者与融烽尊者所在的方向蔓延过去。
这一幕无疑是惊人至极！
以至于阴雷尊者与融烽尊者都不得不后撤，根本不敢停留在原地。
那场面……多少有些滑稽！
明明双方正要硬碰硬
话语落下，一百二十四名被淘汰的士兵都安静了下来，但他们的表情上都是愤怒，如果陈塘不给他们一个合理的说法，那他们是不会服气的。
粥茶散发出一股难以言明的苦味，飘散在空中，就着雨水的冷味，似乎更难闻了。
他难以想象，秦天竟然如此恐怖，又或者说，龙云城城主，同样为他解开了封闭的本源？
闪身想躲，已经来不及了，一条尾巴被齐根切断，落到地上，眨眼化作一根普通的黄皮子尾。
玩家们只要把大部队开过去，杀、烧、抢，也是能够获得地皮。
只不过这种地皮一般都处在各种势力纵横交错的地带，三天两头会遇上各种麻烦。
特务已走出了十几步，才松了一口气，妈的，这么好骗呀。
大概走了二三十米，看到一个工人摸样的人，下了摩托车，站在路旁尿尿，摩托车也没有熄火。
特务乙跳上摩托车，骑了就跑。
刚到场的青年，正是石磊，他目光在释云飞身上淡淡一扫，心头冷笑，而后轻移而开，对身旁的欧阳珍荨笑道。
星轨神色清冷，依然默不作声的进攻，金色瞳孔中光芒闪烁，思绪飞转。
狼崽子‘呜呜’的声音很委屈，仿佛是自己受伤了，在对着陈塘撒娇一样。
“我也想这样问你。”

应馨儿微笑着说道，眼眸里闪过一丝阴冷。
“好，去看看。”
圣枫祖王更是意动，比起李守一来，他去过的地方更少了。
马龙双眼放光，看了看周围的环境，发现自己仿佛被镶如到了冰冻之内，周围已经没有了土壤，而是变成了无边无际冰霜的腹内。
“当、当然是凝萱妹妹了……”
符俊人一把鼻涕一把泪的将事情的来龙去脉说了一遍。
“若雪，不知道什么时候才能与你想见！”
天心望着远方喃喃自语地道。
“雪儿，你怎么了？”
天心也感觉到了若雪的异样，不由柔声地问道。
“那你的意思和哪个公司合作？”
方青阳问道，其实他早就知道了罗强的想法，不过问一问还是必要的，罗强才是老板，这点如果都不懂了的话，那就别混了。
content_en:
Boom!
The power of the entire small world gathered together and merged into the dark blue vortex.
The vortex was expanding, spreading from Wang Teng's head towards the direction of Venerable Yin Lei and Venerable Rong Feng.
This scene is undoubtedly amazing!
So much so that Venerable Yin Lei and Venerable Rong Feng had to retreat, not daring to stay where they were.
That scene... is somewhat funny!
It's clear that the two sides are about to have a head-on confrontation.
After the words fell, the one hundred and twenty-four eliminated soldiers became quiet, but their expressions were filled with anger. If Chen Tang didn't give them a reasonable explanation, they would not be convinced.
The porridge tea gave off an indescribable bitter smell, floating in the air, and it seemed to smell even worse with the cold smell of rain.
It was hard for him to imagine that Qin Tian could be so terrifying, or could it be said that the Lord of Longyun City had also unlocked the source of the seal for him?
He tried to dodge, but it was too late. A tail was cut off at the root and fell to the ground. In the blink of an eye, it turned into an ordinary yellow leather tail.
As long as players drive large troops over and kill, burn, and rob, they can also obtain land.
It's just that this kind of land is usually located in an area where various forces crisscross, and you will encounter all kinds of troubles every three days.
The agent had taken more than ten steps before he breathed a sigh of relief. Damn, it's so easy to deceive.
After walking about twenty or thirty meters, I saw a man who looked like a workman, got off his motorcycle and stood by the roadside to urinate. The motorcycle did not turn off.
Agent B jumped on his motorcycle, rode away and ran away.
The young man who just arrived was Shi Lei. He glanced at Shi Yunfei and sneered in his heart, then moved away slightly and smiled at Ouyang Zhenxun beside him.
Xinggui's expression was cold, and he still attacked silently. The light in his golden pupils flickered, and his thoughts were racing.
The wolf cub's "whining" voice was very aggrieved, as if he was hurt and was acting coquettishly to Chen Tang.
"I want to ask you that too."
Ying Xiner said with a smile, a hint of coldness flashed in her eyes.
"Okay, let's go take a look."
Ancestor King Sheng Feng was even more moved. Compared to Li Shouyi, he had been to fewer places.
Ma Long's eyes shone and he looked at the surrounding environment. He found that he seemed to be embedded in the ice. There was no soil around him, but instead became a belly of endless frost.
"Of course it's sister Ningxuan..."
Fu Junren recounted the whole story with tears in his eyes.
"Ruoxue, I don't know when I can see you again!"
Tianxin looked into the distance and murmured to himself.
"Xue'er, what's wrong with you?"
Tianxin also felt Ruoxue's strangeness and couldn't help asking softly.
"Then which company do you want to cooperate with?"
Fang Qingyang asked. In fact, he already knew what Luo Qiang was thinking, but it was still necessary to ask. Luo Qiang was the boss. If you don't understand this, then don't mess around.
